title: 第2039章 又是讨厌的寄生虫第2038章 古祖出手
slug: 沉睡万年醒来一掌拍碎禁地
content_zh:
第2039章又是讨厌的寄生虫！
场内的古祖等，全都活过了漫长悠久岁月。
他们身后的道统和世族等，更是传承久远，最早可追溯至这处倒悬之地诞生时。
但即便是这样，也不代表他们对整个倒悬之地了如指掌，什么都知道！
眼下这处绝地山脉便是最好的例子！
这处绝地山脉内究竟有什么，存在何等凶险，他们全都一无所知！
“隐藏的力量，因这里的机缘造化将要现世，而走到了明面上！”
一位古祖神色凝重。
他认为陈长生等，跟这处绝地山脉一样神秘莫测，始终都不为人所知。
眼下绝地山脉内的凶险消失，不可想象的机缘造化将要现世，陈长生等也不再隐藏，从暗处走到了明面上！
“竟隐藏着如此恐怖吓人的力量吗？”
“麻烦了！”
所有的古祖等，脸色全都难看无比。
仅是火刀就这么强。
陈长生等的实力，更毋庸置疑，必然要更强。
这让他们全都倍感棘手，更感无力抗衡，觉得他们联手也不是陈长生等的对手！
他们内心对此全都不是滋味，非常的难受与不甘。
绝地山脉内的凶险消失，不可想象的机缘造化将要现世，他们或都将因此而受到大益，拥有更高的成就。
但是现在——
他们所想的很有可能将会成为一场空。

陈长生等过于强大，他们多半争抢不过陈长生等，此地将要现世的机缘造化等，也将会悉数归属于陈长生等！
这种情况下——
他们怎么可能不难受和甘心？
注定不可能！
“你们还要动手吗？”
火刀横在高空，刀身有恐怖火焰腾升，对一众古祖等说道。
一众古祖看着火刀，咬牙都快咬碎了。
他们什么时候这般憋屈难受过？
向来都是他们让对方这般憋屈难受！
然而现在——
他们不仅无比的憋屈难受，还不敢有任何的反抗。
因为他们都感受到了压力和差距。
他们出手的话，下场多半会非常的惨！
不过——
就在这时，有一位古祖竟是开口说道：“诸位不用这么憋屈与难受，谁说我们就对付不了他们？”
他挥手间，祭出一张古图。
古图飞到他们头顶上空，徐徐展开，笼罩住所有的古祖。
“朝升图！”
“你祭出朝升图做什么？”
content_en:
Chapter 2039 Another nasty parasite!
The ancient ancestors in the field have all lived through a long and long time.
The traditions and families behind them have been passed down for a long time, which can be traced back to the birth of this hanging place.
But even so, it doesn't mean that they know everything about the entire upside down land!
The Jedi Mountains right now are the best example!
They have no idea what is in this Jedi mountain range and how dangerous it is!
"The hidden power will come to light due to the chance creation here!"
An ancient ancestor looked solemn.
He believed that Chen Changsheng and others were as mysterious as this Jedi Mountains and had never been known to anyone.
Now that the dangers in the Jedi Mountains have disappeared, unimaginable opportunities are about to appear, Chen Changsheng and others no longer hide, and have stepped out of the darkness into the light!
"Does it actually hide such terrifying and frightening power?"
"Trouble!"
All the ancient ancestors and others looked extremely ugly.
The fire knife alone is so powerful.
There is no doubt that the strength of Chen Changsheng and others must be stronger.
This made them all feel more troublesome and powerless to compete. They felt that together they were no match for Chen Changsheng and others!
They didn't feel good about this at all, they were very uncomfortable and unwilling.
The dangers in the Jedi Mountains have disappeared, and unimaginable opportunities are about to appear. They may all benefit greatly from this and achieve higher achievements.
But now——
What they think may very well be in vain.
Chen Changsheng and others are too powerful, and they will probably not be able to compete with Chen Changsheng and others. All the opportunities and fortunes that will appear here will also belong to Chen Changsheng and others!
In this case——
How could they not feel uncomfortable and be willing to do so?
Destined to be impossible!
"Are you still going to take action?"
The fire knife was lying high in the sky, with terrifying flames rising from the blade, and he said to the ancient ancestors.
All the ancient ancestors gritted their teeth as they looked at the fire knife.
When had they ever felt so depressed and uncomfortable?
They have always made each other feel so miserable!
But now——
Not only were they extremely aggrieved and uncomfortable, they did not dare to resist in any way.
Because they all feel the pressure and gap.
If they take action, the end will probably be very miserable!
But——
At this moment, one of the ancient ancestors actually said: "You don't have to be so aggrieved and uncomfortable. Who said we can't deal with them?"
As he waved his hand, he held out an ancient picture.
The ancient map flew over their heads, slowly unfolded, and enveloped all the ancient ancestors.
"Chaoshengtu!"
"What did you do with the Ascension Picture?"
